name: The Monk - West Cracks - Left Crack

waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: The driving is the easy part of this trip. From Winthrop, head north up the Chewuch River valley on West Chewuch Road / FR-51 — paved the whole way — about 23 miles to the Andrews Creek Trailhead at roughly 3,040 ft, where Andrews Creek Trail #504 starts. Fill out the free self-issue wilderness permit at the trailhead and leave a trailhead parking pass on the car. Everything difficult is on the far side of the parking lot: the walk in runs around 18 miles one way, so load the car for a multi-day trip rather than a day out.
